chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the Umrah, is it obligatory? He said: Yes. I said: Then does it suffice for the one who performs Tamattu'? He said: Yes.

key_terms.تَمَتَّعَ: Performed Tamattu' (a type of Hajj where Umrah is performed first)

ai.seo_question: Is Umrah obligatory and does Tamattu' Hajj count as fulfilling it?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS), the Imam confirms the obligatory status of Umrah, a ruling that distinguishes it from the Sunnah status held by many Sunni schools. The clarification that Tamattu' discharges the Umrah obligation highlights the jurisprudential efficiency of combining rituals, a key feature of Shia Hajj methodology as codified by Shaykh al-Tusi in al-Istibsar.
